title: "Truth of the Shackles"
next_chapter_hook: "Just when Chen Ji thought the clouds had parted and he could see the light, the final message left by Chen Ling struck him like ice into his bones—it was not the eyes of Heavenly Dao that gazed upon him, but an existence far older and more primordial, one that had slumbered since the very dawn of heaven and earth."

text.content: "Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, morning mist still undispersed. Chen Ji sat alone atop the Cliff, his robes flapping violently in the mountain wind, while the faint golden pattern between his brows grew炽热—a sign that the Tianji Record Fragment was resonating with his body. He slowly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the distant mountains' blue outlines, while his mind raced with calculations. That familiar aura from moments ago was unmistakably Chen Ling's. But why would she appear at this moment? And why expose herself to Tianqing Sect's scrutiny at such a critical juncture?"

"Below the Cliff, the sea of clouds churned like tides, yet Chen Ji had no mind to appreciate this rare spectacle. He immersed his consciousness deep into his Mental Sea, where that page of yellowed fragment floated silently in the Void, its surface flowing with cryptic Dao patterns. Mo Xiansheng's voice came at just the right moment, carrying an indescribable depth: 'Do you sense it? That thread of karmic pull... she left something on the path you were bound to take.' Chen Ji offered no reply, merely raising his right hand as a hazy sphere of light materialized in his palm—the technique of karmic追溯 he had perfected over years of bitter cultivation, capable of tracing any figure's trajectory along destiny's threads to any point in the past."

"The light gradually coalesced, and a blurry figure slowly materialized before Chen Ji's eyes. It was the back view of a middle-aged man, dressed in coarse homespun cloth, yet radiating a heart-stopping pressure. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—the man, though a complete stranger, shared a startling seventy percent resemblance in the outline of that back, those slightly hunched shoulder blades. 'Chen Xuan...' he murmured, his voice carrying a tremor he himself had not noticed. The creator of the Tianji Record, that legendary supreme figure, now appeared before him in such a manner. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul rippled slightly, as if sighing in silence."

dialogue.content: "'You have finally come.' The blurry figure did not turn, yet its voice clearly entered Chen Ji's Mental Sea. 'I have waited for this day... far too long.' Chen Xuan's tone held not a trace of reproach, but rather an inexplicable sense of relief. 'When I divided the Tianji Record into nine fragments, binding each with shackles, it was never my intention to imprison those who would inherit it... but to protect them. To protect them from being assimilated by Heavenly Dao.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart trembled violently, as if some impenetrable fortress had just crumbled. He unconsciously clenched his fists, his knuckles whitening from the force. 'Protect?' His voice was hoarse, barely recognizable as his own. 'Does not every use of the Tianji Record's power consume my Heavenly Fate Value? Is that not eroding my lifespan? Is that not driving me step by step toward the abyss?' He drew a deep breath, his chest heaving violently as he struggled to suppress the churning emotions. Yet the images inevitably flooded his mind—the utter exhaustion after every premonition of the future, the terror of his lifespan shortening with each drain of Heavenly Fate."

dialogue.content: "'What you see is merely the surface.' Chen Xuan's figure slowly turned halfway, revealing a face weathered by countless storms yet still resolute, its brow and temples etched deep with the marks of time. 'The Tianji Record was originally an extension of Heavenly Dao's will, and I... once attempted to sever its connection to Heavenly Dao. I failed. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao are omnipresent. Anyone who directly bears its power will be gradually assimilated, ultimately becoming its puppet. So I chose another path—dispersing the power so that each inheritor holds only a portion.'"

text.content: "Mountain winds howled past, yet Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. He finally understood the true purpose of those shackles—they were not chains, but firewalls. Every consumption of Heavenly Fate Value was burning himself to shield against Heavenly Dao's erosion; every bout of weakness after foresight was his body automatically repairing the traces of Heavenly Dao's contamination. 'So the so-called deadly backlash...' His voice turned low. 'Is merely the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's revenge. It punishes everyone who attempts to break free from its control.' Mo Xiansheng remained silent, that weak soul fragment seemingly avoiding something deliberately."

"'Then... how does one break the shackles?' Chen Ji asked the answer he most desperately wished to know. Chen Xuan's figure began to fade further, as if about to dissipate into the wind at any moment. He paused for a moment before speaking: 'The method to break the shackles lies not in removal, but in completion.' His voice grew ethereal. 'When your cultivation is strong enough, when your will is firm enough, when you can completely control the Tianji Record without being harmed by its backlash—the shackles will dissolve of their own accord. Because by then, you will have earned the qualification to stand against Heavenly Dao.'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath, temporarily suppressing the shock in his heart. Two vastly different paths materialized before him—one was to follow Chen Xuan's guidance, quietly accumulate strength, and wait for the shackles to naturally dissolve; the other was to question the authenticity of all this, after all, Mo Xiansheng had yet to speak a word—who was to say this was not another trap?"

choices.description: "Since the shackles are protection rather than imprisonment, follow Chen Xuan's guidance, accumulate strength, and bide time until the moment is ripe."
choices.visible_cost: "Will require more time to break through"
choices.visible_reward: "Receive further guidance from Chen Xuan, learn more secrets of the Tianji Record"
choices.risk_hint: "May miss certain opportunities for rapid advancement"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly nodded, carving Chen Xuan's words into the depths of his Mental Sea without missing a single character. He raised his head, his gaze gaining renewed firmness and resolve. Since the path ahead was now clear, there was no need for further hesitation. He turned to gaze at the distant horizon, where clouds churned and several sharp sword lights faintly streaked across—that was Tianqing Sect's patrol disciples. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, revealing a meaningful smile. From this day forth, he was no longer the废物 who knew only to hide his talents, but a chess master who held Heavenly Secrets and had the world in his heart."

choices.description: "Everything Chen Xuan said was too perfect, while Mo Xiansheng remained silent throughout. There must be something amiss— clarification is a must."
choices.visible_reward: "Uncover the hidden truth about Mo Xiansheng"
choices.risk_hint: "Mo Xiansheng may consequently refuse to share more information"

text.content: "Chen Xuan's figure gradually faded, but Chen Ji did not leave. Instead, he turned his gaze to that weak soul fragment deep within his Mental Sea. 'Mo Xiansheng,' his voice cold as icicles in the depth of winter, 'what explanation do you have for what Chen Xuan said?' The soul fragment quivered violently, and after a long silence finally spoke, its voice carrying a trace of bitterness: 'What he said... is all true. But there is one thing he did not tell you.'"

choices.description: "Neither blindly accept nor recklessly question, but instead carve a different route, seeking other possibilities to break the shackles."
choices.visible_reward: "May discover the hidden ultimate secret of the Tianji Record"
choices.risk_hint: "May provoke anger from both Chen Xuan and Mo Xiansheng"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not rush to declare his stance, but instead rapidly deduced various possibilities within his Mental Sea. Chen Xuan's words seemed flawless, yet it was precisely this perfection that sparked a thread of vigilance in his heart. He spoke slowly: 'Chen Xuan Senior, forgive this junior's bluntness. You said the shackles were for protection, but if that were truly the case, why did every inheritor throughout history die violent deaths? You spoke of opposing Heavenly Dao, yet you yourself... where did you ultimately end up?' The words fell into a deathly silence within the Mental Sea."

"At this moment, a faint fluctuation arrived from afar, interrupting Chen Ji's contemplation. It was Chen Ling's aura, yet even more ethereal than before, like a dying candle flame in the wind, flickering at any moment. Chen Ji's pupils constricted, his palm rapidly forming seals as a message instantly pierced through the layers of mist, reaching that familiar aura. Her response was only a断续 of whispered words: 'Brother... be careful... those eyes... are not...' Before the words could finish, the connection severed completely."

dialogue.content: "'She is correct.' Mo Xiansheng's voice finally emerged, carrying unprecedented gravity. 'The Eyes of Heavenly Dao... are not the ultimate enemy. They are merely one of the pieces set in motion by That Existence. The Tianji Record, the Taixu Mirror, the Wheel of Reincarnation... all these so-called ancient divine artifacts were forged by That Existence亲手 during the primordial era. Its purpose has never been to rule the Three Realms—but to annihilate every existence that could potentially threaten it, eliminating them before they can sprout.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt his mind explode like thunder, countless fragments reorganizing frantically at this moment. The Tianji Record was not opportunity but cage; the Eyes of Heavenly Dao were not destination but chess piece; and he himself... from beginning to end, was merely an ant being manipulated by older, greater forces. A surge of boundless fury rose from the depths of his heart, yet was forcibly suppressed the next instant. He drew a deep breath, slowly opening his eyes, which had regained their customary serenity and depth. What use is rage? What benefit is hatred? Since he had entered the game, there was only one path—to see it through to the end."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ling's connection had severed, but her warning echoed like thunder beside Chen Ji's ears. He closed his eyes, rapidly deducing all possibilities within his Mental Sea. Those eyes—did they refer to the Eyes of Heavenly Dao? Or someone else entirely? Or perhaps... was Chen Ling's situation within the Holy Sect far more dangerous than he had imagined?"

choices.description: "My sister's safety outweighs everything—even if the path ahead leads through dragon's pools and tiger's lairs, I must venture forth."
choices.visible_cost: "May alert the enemy and expose one's true strength"
choices.visible_reward: "Opportunity to rescue Chen Ling and uncover more truth"
choices.risk_hint: "The Holy Sect abounds with experts; reckless action may result in being surrounded"

text.content: "Chen Ji rose abruptly, his entire body's qi surging to its absolute peak. His toes touched the ground and he transformed into a streak of light, dashing toward where Chen Ling's aura had vanished. Wind screamed past his ears as his divine sense spread outward like a tide, searching every thread of possible clues. Moments later, he detected a trace of residual aura in a valley dozens of li away—an aura mixed with blood and char, clearly the aftermath of a fierce battle."

choices.description: "Reckless action will only alert the enemy; better to first ascertain the enemy's true capabilities before making decisions."
choices.visible_cost: "May miss the optimal timing to rescue Chen Ling"
choices.visible_reward: "Can more comprehensively understand the enemy's layout"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Ling may come to harm during this period"

text.content: "Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his mounting anxiety, his form flickering as he re-immersed himself into the Void. He observed the surroundings from concealment, memorizing every suspicious aura into his Mental Sea. Moments later, several black shadows swept past from afar, their auras cold and eerie—those were scouts from the Holy Sect. They had clearly sensed Chen Ling's presence too and were searching everywhere. Chen Ji's gaze darkened, and he had already calculated his plan. Since the Holy Sect was also hunting Chen Ling, he would let them fight it out first while he reaped the benefits."

choices.description: "Su Qingyao is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow with considerable strength and thorough knowledge of Tianqing Sect—she is the ideal partner."
choices.visible_cost: "May expose his relationship with Chen Ling"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain the support of a powerful ally"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao has always harbored suspicions about him; she may use this opportunity to investigate deeper"

text.content: "Chen Ji deliberated briefly, then withdrew a communication Jade Slip from his sleeve and injected a thread of divine sense into it. Moments later, a cool voice rang within his Mental Sea: 'Chen Ji? Contacting me at this hour—what do you want?' It was Su Qingyao. The corner of Chen Ji's mouth lifted slightly, revealing a perfectly calibrated expression of anxiety and earnestness: 'Senior Sister Su, I have intelligence about a treasure emerging from a ruin, but it seems the Holy Sect has set its sights on it... I wish to invite Senior Sister to accompany me—would that be acceptable?' The other end of the line fell silent for a moment, as if she were discerning the truth within his words."

"Within the Mental Sea, Chen Xuan's residual image had completely vanished, yet his words seared themselves into Chen Ji's heart like brands. The Tianji Record was insurance, meant to counter the true enemy—so from beginning to end, he had not been playing chess, but had been pushed forward by a greater player. This realization filled him with suffocating fury, yet he could not deny its precision. Had it not been for Chen Xuan's arrangement, he would have been assimilated by Heavenly Dao the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, becoming the next puppet of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao."

"The mountain wind remained biting, yet Chen Ji's heart was unexpectedly calm. He sat cross-legged atop the Cliff, allowing the violent gusts to buffet his robes and hair. Within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated, emanating a soft golden glow. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, carrying a rare gentleness: 'You have accepted all this faster than any inheritor in history. Perhaps... this is why you were chosen.' Chen Ji offered no reply, merely closing his eyes slightly. He did not need to be chosen—he only needed to become the one who holds the chess pieces."

"At this moment, a faint yet clear message pierced through the Void once more, entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was Chen Ling's final residual divine sense, and its contents caused Chen Ji's originally serene features to freeze instantly. 'Brother, the true enemy... is not the Eyes of Heavenly Dao...' Her voice was fragmented, yet each word cut like a blade. 'It is That Which existed since the very dawn of heaven and earth...' The words cut off abruptly, as if some force was deliberately preventing her from speaking that name. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, and within his pupils, stormy seas churned. He finally understood—the enemy he would face was far more terrifying and far more ancient than he had ever imagined."
